prevention_observations.note: Quantified findings for a later integrity-prevention phase; NOT implemented here.
prevention_observations.ip_blocked_sources: The datacenter/built-in-browser IP is hard-blocked (CloudFront 403 / Cloudflare challenge) on ~70% of NAIA athletics hosts (Sidearm, PrestoSports). Recovery required the operator's residential browser. A durable pipeline needs a non-datacenter fetch path or a documented BLOCKED residual.
prevention_observations.stale_staff: 29 legacy coaches proven DEPARTED; 6 role-changed (e.g. promoted to HC).
prevention_observations.same_name_contamination: 5 legacy rows filed under the wrong same-name school (University of Saint Francis IN used Joliet-IL stfrancis.edu; correct host sf.edu).
prevention_observations.changed_email: 4 coaches whose stored (often inferred) email no longer matches the published address; 5 wrong-person.
prevention_observations.inferred_email_gap: 65 legacy addresses were inferred and are simply not published on the official page (cannot be corroborated) -> confirms inferred emails must never be promoted.
prevention_observations.unverifiable: 29 addresses unverifiable from any readable official page.
prevention_observations.source_host_changed: Several schools moved athletics to a main-.edu subdomain or a new branded host (e.g. athletics.umdearborn.edu); 2 DOMAIN_REOPEN programmes (TAMU-Texarkana tamuteagles.prestosports.com, Mount Mary mountmary.prestosports.com) held for a domain phase.
prevention_observations.programme_lifecycle: Siena Heights University announced closure at the end of 2025-26 (active this year) — flag for lifecycle handling.
